nodes.label: ADR-001 — DDD Layered Architecture with Enforced Import Direction
nodes.rationale: Obsidian plugins are long-running processes sharing a JS runtime with other plugins. Clean layer boundaries enable: unit-testing domain/application logic without Obsidian; running UI in browser via MockBridge; replacing bridge implementations without touching business logic; extending with agentonomous in v2.0 without coupling Vue to agent runtime.

nodes.label: DDD Layered Architecture (domain ← application ← infrastructure ← ui)
